data.content_ref: inline:The target's justification is self-referentially inductive. The mechanism claims the preference is 'not an inductive inference about the future' yet justifies it as 'the only strategy that doesn't lead to immediate extinction (error).' This justification requires projecting that survival-based preference will continue to avoid extinction because it has been a 'biological/psychological inevitability' — which is itself an inductive inference from past/present fitness to future fitness. The target thus smuggles in exactly the inferential pattern it explicitly disclaims, undermining its own core claim that the defense avoids induction.
